findings.source_quote: over four months since the coronavirus pandemic started
findings.suggested_fix: Change “drygt fyra månader” to “mer än fyra månader” to preserve the source’s “over four months” without implying only a little over four months.
findings.translation_quote: drygt fyra månader sedan coronapandemin började

findings.source_quote: through our communities, churches, and society as a whole
findings.suggested_fix: Use distinct terms for all three groups, for example “genom våra lokalsamhällen, församlingar och samhället i stort”; the current wording repeats “samhälle”.
findings.translation_quote: genom våra samhällen, församlingar och hela samhället

findings.suggested_fix: Translate this as “våra mennonitiska/amishiska församlingar” or another contextually accurate rendering of “plain communities”; “traditionella samfund” is broader and changes the group being discussed.

findings.source_quote: In 1 Peter, the apostle Peter calls us to “honor the king”
findings.suggested_fix: Use “I Första Petrusbrevet” rather than “I Första Petrusbrevet” is acceptable; however, avoid shifting “honor” to an inconsistent or narrower sense. Current quotation and surrounding explanation are broadly faithful.
findings.translation_quote: I Första Petrusbrevet uppmanar aposteln Petrus oss att ”ära kungen”

findings.suggested_fix: Replace “traditionellt samfund” with a contextually accurate translation of “plain community,” consistent with the earlier occurrence.

findings.source_quote: When Ananias the high priest asked the ones by him to smite him
findings.suggested_fix: Use the conventional Swedish name “Ananias” only if that is the intended source name, but correct the event’s subject: Ananias ordered those standing by to strike Paul. Suggested wording: “När översteprästen Ananias bad dem som stod bredvid att slå Paulus …”.
findings.translation_quote: När översteprästen Hannas bad dem som stod bredvid honom att slå Paulus

findings.source_quote: Many of the plain community tend to distrust the government’s way of handling the situation.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “de traditionella samfunden” with a contextually accurate rendering of “the plain community,” consistent with the other occurrences.
findings.translation_quote: Många i de traditionella samfunden tenderar att misstro hur staten hanterar situationen.

findings.source_quote: The Apostle Peter said that …God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind –2 Timothy 1:7.
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve the source’s attribution to Peter and translate the quoted wording faithfully. For example: “Aposteln Petrus sade att …Gud har inte gett oss en fruktans ande, utan kraftens, kärlekens och ett sunt sinnes ande –2 Timoteusbrevet 1:7.” The current Swedish quote changes “fear” to “modlöshet” and omits the “sound mind” distinction.
findings.translation_quote: Aposteln Petrus sade att …Gud har inte gett oss modlöshetens ande, utan kraftens, kärlekens och självbehärskningens ande –2 Timoteusbrevet 1:7.

findings.source_quote: The unity within our groups is being challenged in ways it has not been before.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “våra grupper” with a contextually accurate translation of “our plain communities,” such as “våra mennonitiska/amishiska gemenskaper,” as appropriate to the publication’s terminology.
findings.translation_quote: Enheten inom våra grupper prövas på sätt som den inte har prövats tidigare.
